title: Python for Data Engineers
tagline: From scripts to trusted pipelines — warehouse data the company can use
description: A three-level Python curriculum for Data Engineers. Focus on SQL, modeling, ETL/ELT, orchestration, and reliability — so analysts and scientists inherit clean, documented data.
prerequisites: Programming fundamentals (Python preferred; Java/Scala is a plus)
Comfort using a terminal, Git, and cloud consoles at a beginner level

levels.title: Python & Warehouse Foundations
levels.goal: Write Python that moves and shapes data, with solid SQL and modeling basics

topics.title: Python essentials
items: Error handling and logging (not print-only scripts)

topics.title: SQL & modeling
items: Advanced SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions
Star/snowflake schemas at a conceptual level

topics.title: Extract & load
items: Pulling from APIs and databases with Python

projects: Script that pulls an API into Postgres or a local warehouse
SQL model of transactions → dim/fact tables
Logged, retry-aware load job with a README

levels.title: Pipeline Engineering
levels.goal: Build scheduled ETL/ELT with tests, transformations, and observable failures

topics.title: Airflow
items: Local Airflow vs. managed (MWAA/Cloud Composer) at a high level

topics.title: Data quality
items: Great Expectations or dbt tests in practice
Alerting when row counts or freshness slip

topics.title: Cloud warehouses
items: Change data capture at a working level
IAM and least-privilege for pipeline identities

projects: Airflow DAG: raw events → warehouse tables
dbt project with tests and docs site
Quality checks on a payments or M-Pesa-style transaction feed

levels.title: Reliable Data Platforms
levels.goal: Operate pipelines at scale with CDC, streaming awareness, and clear lineage

topics.title: Incremental architecture
items: Batch vs. micro-batch vs. stream — when each is enough

topics.title: Platform practices
items: Dockerizing jobs and CI for dbt/pytest
Cost, SLAs, and on-call for pipeline failures

topics.title: Lineage & contracts
items: Serving analysts and ML without copy-paste tables

projects: End-to-end pipeline: raw events → warehouse → documented marts
Lineage diagram and runbook for a failed DAG
SACCO/fintech-style ledger tables with quality gates
